question.value: What are the physical properties of the densest structures (fragmentation, kinematics, jet/outflow vs disk) in the high-mass hot core G351.77-0.54 at sub-50 au resolution?

evidence.quote: We aim to resolve the dust and gas emission at the highest spatial resolution to study the physical properties of the densest structures during high-mass star formation.

claims.hypothesis: Does thermal Jeans fragmentation continue to sub-1000 au scales in high-mass cores?
claims.experiment: 1.3 mm long-baseline continuum, core identification, masses and separations compared with Jeans estimates
claims.result: 12 sub-sources; separations sub-100 to >1000 au; masses 0.01-2.5 Msun
claims.finding: Separations and masses are largely consistent with thermal Jeans fragmentation

evidence.quote: The core separations and approximate masses are largely consistent with thermal Jeans fragmentation of a dense gas core.

claims.hypothesis: Does the velocity gradient in emission lines toward mm1 trace an inner disk or the jet/outflow?
claims.experiment: Moment, channel and PV maps of the 217.82 GHz and SiO lines compared with CO and CH3CN from earlier work
claims.result: Gradient aligned with the outflow and perpendicular to the CH3CN rotation
claims.finding: Likely jet/outflow, a disk contribution not excluded

evidence.quote: While we cannot exclude that these observational features stem from an inner hot accretion disk, the alignment with the outflow rather suggests that it stems from the inner jet and outflow region.

claims.hypothesis: Which entrainment process dominates on small scales?
claims.experiment: PV diagrams of the high-excitation line and SiO
claims.result: Highest velocities near the center, no Hubble law
claims.finding: Consistent with turbulent entrainment via Kelvin-Helmholtz instabilities

evidence.quote: on these small scales, the position-velocity diagnostics are more consistent with turbulent entrainment at the jet-outflow interface.

why_this_method.value: Only baselines >55 m used to concentrate on compact structures because short baselines are sparsely sampled

evidence.quote: Therefore, in the imaging process we only used data from baselines longer than 55 m, which allows us to concentrate on the most compact structures.

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: Keplerian disk interpretation of the velocity gradient considered but disfavoured because of the outflow alignment

evidence.quote: However, several observational features argue against this interpretation.

limitations_admitted.value: Masses and column densities are lower limits because of high optical depth and missing flux; the distance is uncertain

evidence.quote: we stress that these values have to be considered as lower limits because of the high optical depth as well as the large amount of missing flux.
